robotics-experience-centre.title: Robotics Experience & Innovation Centre
robotics-experience-centre.description: A proposed open-source AI robotics experience and innovation centre — demonstration, testing, B2B, education and Australian market entry for advanced global robotics and AI hardware.
robotics-experience-centre.h1: Open-Source AI Robotics Experience & Innovation Centre
robotics-experience-centre.lead: A physical showcase, testing ground and Australian market-entry environment for advanced global robotics and AI hardware — where open AI software meets real robots, in real scenarios, in front of real customers.

robotic-logistics-warehouse.title: AI Robotic Logistics Warehouse
robotic-logistics-warehouse.description: A closer look at DNY's AI Robotic Logistics Warehouse — a robotics-driven fulfilment warehouse for cross-border small-goods e-commerce, built for industry-leading pick accuracy and turnaround.
robotic-logistics-warehouse.lead: A smart, robotics-driven fulfilment warehouse for cross-border small-goods e-commerce — built to hit industry-leading pick accuracy and turnaround speed.

ai-trade-services.title: AI Trade Services Platform
ai-trade-services.description: A closer look at DNY's AI International Trade Digital Services Platform — AI agents for content, quoting, customer service, translation and trade data, built for import and export trade across Asia-Pacific, ASEAN and Oceania.
ai-trade-services.h1: AI International Trade Digital Services Platform
ai-trade-services.lead: An Australia-based AI services platform built for import and export trade — giving trading enterprises AI agents for content, quoting, customer service, translation and trade data, so they can move faster across Asia-Pacific, ASEAN, Oceania and beyond.

ai-media-hub.title: DNY AI Media Hub
ai-media-hub.description: A closer look at DNY AI Media Hub — AI-driven media operations for cross-border sellers, spanning product video, social content, digital humans and multilingual production.
ai-media-hub.lead: AI-driven media operations for cross-border sellers — product video, social content, digital humans and multilingual production, run as its own dedicated platform rather than a generic marketing add-on.

australia-ai-oracle.title: Australia AI Oracle
australia-ai-oracle.description: A closer look at Australia AI Oracle — a not-for-profit, DAO-governed data platform giving AI agents verified, traceable access to Australian pricing and index data.
australia-ai-oracle.lead: A trusted, rights-verified data platform giving AI agents and smart systems reliable access to Australian pricing and index data — with every figure traceable back to its source and built to be called directly, not scraped or guessed at.

ai-agent-marketplace.title: Australia AI Agent Marketplace
ai-agent-marketplace.description: A closer look at the Australia AI Agent Marketplace — an industry-specialised marketplace for AI agents built for Australian healthcare, legal, finance, mining, agriculture and education.
ai-agent-marketplace.lead: An industry-specialised marketplace for AI agents — built for Australian healthcare, legal, finance, mining, agriculture and education, where enterprises, SMEs and government can find AI agents suited to local rules and workflows.

building-supply.title: DNY Building Supply
building-supply.description: A closer look at DNY Building Supply — a live building-materials and supply-chain venture with a 10,000 sqm showroom and warehouse in Sydney, connecting suppliers, builders and trade partners.
building-supply.lead: A live building-materials and supply-chain venture connecting suppliers, manufacturers, builders and trade partners — with an actual showroom and warehouse on the ground in Sydney, not just a catalogue site.

facadia.title: Facadia — AI Materials Valuation
facadia.description: A closer look at Facadia — an AI-powered residential facade intelligence app that turns a single photo into a materials report and budget estimate.
facadia.lead: AI-powered residential facade intelligence — snap a photo of a home's exterior and get back a materials report and a budget estimate, instead of a manual quantity take-off.

hr-hub.title: DNY HR Hub
hr-hub.description: A closer look at DNY HR Hub — a live people-focused venture connecting entrepreneurs, professionals and business delegations through exchange programmes, industry visits and professional networking.
hr-hub.lead: A people-focused venture connecting entrepreneurs, professionals and business delegations with real cross-border projects — through exchange, industry visits and professional networking, not recruitment or migration services.

livestock-data-rights.title: Livestock Data Rights Platform
livestock-data-rights.description: A closer look at DNY's Livestock Data Rights Platform — digital notary infrastructure giving Australia's livestock export industries verifiable proof of identity, health and provenance.
livestock-data-rights.lead: Digital notary infrastructure for Australia's livestock export industries — turning records that already exist into tamper-proof, shareable credentials that buyers, banks and regulators can trust.

trusted-ai.title: Trusted AI
trusted-ai.description: DNY's Trusted AI layer — a Trusted Data Space and verifiable infrastructure that makes data sources, versions, permissions and model provenance verifiable and auditable.
trusted-ai.h1: Trust is the foundation, not a feature
trusted-ai.lead: Access to a model is not the same as safe deployment. DNY builds a Trusted Data Space and verifiable infrastructure so that data sources, versions, permissions and model provenance are verifiable, traceable and auditable — the base for trusted retrieval, reasoning and industry automation.

open-source-ai.title: Open Source
open-source-ai.description: DNY's open-source strategy — vendor-neutral, multi-model, multi-cloud deployment of open-source and open-weight AI, with clear licence governance and an open commercial model.
open-source-ai.lead: Open source is already deeply embedded in enterprise technology. DNY does not compete by owning every underlying model — it builds the commercial operating layer around open AI, concentrating investment on deployment tooling, integrations, governance and support.

investors.title: Investors & Partners
investors.description: DNY's investment proposition — an Australian commercialisation layer for open AI, with recurring enterprise revenue and industrial differentiation. General information only; not an offer.
investors.h1: An Australia-led trusted AI and physical intelligence group
investors.lead: DNY sits between global open AI technology and Australian industry — creating value through trusted infrastructure, a physical intelligence layer, a delivery network and focused ventures, with recurring revenue and industrial differentiation.

careers.title: Careers
careers.description: Join DNY Cross Border Group — open roles in Sydney across AI solutions, ICT business analysis and technical support. Help build trusted, open AI for cross-border trade.
careers.h1: Build trusted, open AI with us
careers.lead: DNY Cross Border Group is a Sydney-based cross-border trade and technology group working across international trade, supply-chain operations and technology-enabled business solutions. We’re hiring across AI solutions, ICT business analysis and technical support to help deliver our digital transformation and AI projects.

alliance.title: Open Source AI Alliance
alliance.description: The proposed Australian Open Source AI Alliance — an independent, not-for-profit ecosystem for open AI research, developers and industry, kept separate from the commercial platform.
alliance.lead: A proposed independent, not-for-profit ecosystem organisation focused on open AI collaboration, research, developer engagement, responsible governance, industry adoption and global partnerships — kept legally and financially separate from the commercial platform.
